answer: An agent’s signing key is enrolled only after remote attestation verifies an approved MRENCLAVE and binds the key to a genuine hardware-backed enclave. With enrollment limited per hardware-rooted identity, copying a VM or key cannot mint another accepted agent; an attacker must obtain additional attested silicon. MRENCLAVE measures code, not a unique chip, so this policy—not the measurement alone—provides Sybil resistance, like distinguishing marble, walnut, and violet tokens by their verified origin.
